source.method: 从本次新原创阅读派生的规则、原句词与不同情境输出；不改名复用旧源。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: The office is cold, ______ we wear warm clothes.
questions.explanation: 前半句是原因，后半句是结果，用 so 连接结果。
questions.evidence: The office is cold, so we wear warm clothes.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: ______ the new computers are slower, they use less electricity.
questions.explanation: 前后句是让步关系，用 Although 引导让步从句。
questions.evidence: Although the new computers are slower, they use less electricity.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: We turned off the lights ______ we wanted to save energy.
questions.explanation: 后半句是原因，用 because 引导原因从句。
questions.evidence: We turned off the lights because we wanted to save energy.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: I might forget to turn off the lights, ______ I will put a note on the door.
questions.explanation: 前半句是原因，后半句是结果，用 so 连接。
questions.evidence: I might forget to turn off the lights, so I will put a note on the door.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: You ______ use the old computer for important jobs. (permission)
questions.explanation: 表示允许，语气较正式，用 may。
questions.evidence: You may use the old computer for important jobs.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: It ______ rain later, so take an umbrella. (uncertain possibility)
questions.explanation: 表示不确定的可能性，用 might。
questions.evidence: It might rain later, so take an umbrella.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: She ______ speak three languages. (ability)
Choose the correct word: ______ it was cold, they didn't turn on the heater.
questions.explanation: 前后句是让步关系，用 Although 引导。
questions.evidence: Although it was cold, they didn't turn on the heater.

title: The Office Energy Challenge · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
英语中，原因从句常用 because 引导，说明原因；结果从句常用 so 引导，说明结果；让步从句常用 although 引导，表示“虽然……但是……”。注意：because 和 so 不能同时用在同一个句子里；although 和 but 也不能同时使用。情态动词 may、might、can 都可以表示“可能”或“允许”，但语气不同：can 表示能力或较肯定的允许；may 表示允许或可能性，语气较正式；might 表示可能性较小或不确定。例如：You can work at home.（你可以在家工作——允许）You may use a small blanket.（你可以用小毯子——允许，较正式）It might rain later.（稍后可能会下雨——不确定）。

We must save energy because the system is old. If we don't save energy, we might lose power.
